objective: Compose v75's high-capacity one-pass mixed-cell down projection with a compact rank-16 INT8 activation-subspace adapter fitted only to its remaining MLP residual, so the cell path captures common local structure and the skinny path captures prompt-varying correction directions.

parent_findings.conclusion: Static cell support already uses its global scale well, while forcing prompt-robust substitutions destroys CQ3 cells. Preserve v75 and represent only its remaining prompt-varying error in a shared low-rank activation subspace.

prior_exact_kernel_evidence.boundary: The existing kernel establishes exact packed rank-16 INT8 algebra and bounded isolated execution for 5120-by-5120 adapters. v79 must still validate the new 17408-by-5120 payload and later integrate and time the composition end to end.

scope.base_candidate: frozen v75 three-projection MLP with its byte-identical hybrid down payload
scope.adapter_input: the 17408-dimensional BF16 output of the frozen v44 CQ3 gate/up SwiGLU
scope.adapter_target: exact BF16 down-projection MLP output minus the frozen v75 hybrid MLP output

adapter.fit: dual ridge regression from centered gate/up activation rows to the residual remaining after the frozen v75 hybrid output, followed by exact thin QR/SVD truncation
adapter.storage: INT8 left and right factors with one FP16 scale per rank direction and FP16 output bias recentered after factor quantization

canonical_composition.execution: one existing mixed-cell down pass followed by INT8-times-FP16 skinny projection to rank 16, INT8-times-FP16 expansion to 5120, and fused bias add

data_status.allowed_use: Reject or admit this exact composition to a second untouched prompt cache only.

decision.if_pass: Freeze both payload hashes and collect a second newly authored prompt cache before representative-layer or kernel-integration promotion.
decision.if_fail: Reject rank-16 residual composition without sweeping rank or ridge on either development set.

claim_boundary: Development-only layer-59 screen of a hierarchical mixed-cell plus rank-16 INT8 activation-subspace residual. A pass only authorizes a new-prompt replication; it does not establish whole-model quality, benchmark retention, CPU throughput, energy, novelty, 100 tokens per second, or a breakthrough.
